text:
Hi! I am Argentinian too. In Argentina, they usually don’t give you the original birth certificate, but certified copies.

Mine was also a copy of the handwritten certificate and didn’t look very high quality, but I submitted it with the apostille and Hebrew translation, and I had no issues at Misrad Hapnim in Hadera.

The only difference is that I got the physical copy in Argentina (bc I could not get it digitally), so it was apostilled there, and then my mom sent it to me, and I translated it into Hebrew here in Israel.
